sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the victim is a married woman and for last three years she continued her relationship with the petitioner.

Thereafter she lodged a false case against the petitioner stating that petitioner had threatened her to publish some photographs of their relationship in social media but the petitioner has no knowledge about the social media.
Under such backdrop, the benefit of pre-arrest bail may be extended to the petitioner.

5. It is submitted on behalf of the informant that even after the petitioner was granted interim bail,
he has sent objectionable messages to the victim.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has vehemently denied such allegations against the petitioner.
6. I have considered the submissions at the Bar with circumspection.
7. I have perused the Case Diary.
8. The petitioner has appeared before the Investigating officer and his statements have been recorded.

It appears that despite the submission of the learned counsel for the informant that the petitioner has violated bail conditions, the petitioner may be granted bail as he has appeared before the Investigating Page No.# 3/3 Officer and co-operated with the investigation.
9. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner has pledged to abide by any stringent bail conditions if he is granted bail.
11. On breach of any of the bail conditions, bail order shall stand automatically cancelled.
12. Send back the Case Diary.
